Setup Action

  • In Details, if using a template, link this action to that template.
  • In Details add any required input fields that are used in the action payload.
  • In Action Settings under Linked Metadata Sources link data required to build the action payload.
  • In Action Settings under Payload update script template to match requirements for this action. 
  • In Action Settings under Output Templates update for the desired content (Markdown, HTML, or JSON) to store on the step when complete. 
  • In Test Action confirm your payload and output is handled properly.

Payload Settings

Create the script template to build the payload for running this action.

Linked Metadata Sources

Link required metadata sources for the script template.

Output Settings

Fields that have content will be rendered with Jinja on the step output after the action is complete.

Test Action Payload Script and Output

Render the action payload script using the jinja_vars collected for a device to create example data.
